scenarios.name: life-op-first-life-loss-adds-counter
scenarios.why: Vengeful Warchief triggers the first time its controller loses life each turn ("Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn"). The harness "life" op emits a real logged LifeChange, so a -1 to p0 queues the trigger; resolving it puts one +1/+1 counter on the Warchief.
